verdict.rationale: HelixDB is a database/backend product that exposes its own functionality via an MCP server (helixdb-docs-8, helixdb-probe-3) for other agents to consume — it is not itself an AI agent or assistant that would plug in and consume other MCP servers' tools. This story's axis (a product acting as an MCP client to use external tools) is a category error for a database product, not a gap in its offering.
